annotations.title: Show plans and get an upgrade link

description: Returns PostWire's paid plans with their monthly price and what each includes (posts a month, brands, AI drafts a day), the account's current plan, and a checkout link for one plan (the next plan up when none is given). The link opens a Stripe payment page in the browser and nothing is charged unless the user pays there; for an account that already has a subscription it opens the plan page of the PostWire dashboard.

plan.description: Plan to check out. Omit for the next plan up.
